name: MS-Agent
description: ModelScope's agent framework and assistant for long-running tasks, with web UI, TUI and CLI entry points.
whatItDoes: MS-Agent provides a customisable productivity assistant that combines models, tools, skills and sub-agents, with project memory and scheduling to keep long tasks moving.
howItWorks: A harness manages planning, context, permissions and execution feedback around the agent loop, with tools attached through MCP. It is started as a web UI, terminal UI or one-shot run.

requirements.name: MODELSCOPE_API_KEY
requirements.description: ModelScope API-Inference key; other OpenAI-compatible providers also work

run: ms-agent run --query "Introduce the applications of MS-Agent"
